top_news.title: St. Louis Cardinals Takes 2-1 Win
top_news.summary: St. Louis Cardinals beat Cincinnati Reds 2-1. Dane Myers: 2 H, 1 HR, 1 RBI, 4 AB Quinn Mathews: 4.0 IP, 7 K, 1 ER, 3 BB, 2 H Dane Myers homers (4) on a fly ball to left field.

top_news.title: Cincinnati Reds Takes 5-6 Win
top_news.summary: Cincinnati Reds beat St. Louis Cardinals 5-6. Iván Herrera: 1 H, 1 HR, 1 RBI, 4 AB Peter Strzelecki: 3.0 IP, 4 K, 1 ER, 0 BB, 2 H Elly De La Cruz doubles (19) on a ground ball to left fielder José Fermín, deflected by third baseman Blaze Jordan. Tyler Stephenson scores.

top_news.title: Tampa Bay Rays Takes 6-7 Win
top_news.summary: Tampa Bay Rays beat Baltimore Orioles 6-7. Christian Encarnacion-Strand: 3 H, 1 HR, 4 RBI, 5 AB Cam Sanders: 2.0 IP, 3 K, 0 ER, 0 BB, 0 H Jonny DeLuca singles on a ground ball to left fielder Leody Taveras. Yandy Díaz scores. Jonathan Aranda scores. Junior Caminero to 2nd.
